clue.text: Making way for sailors, chaplain's up the creek

indicators.note: up the creek means in a mess, so the letters of the word before it are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A naval chaplain makes way for sailors but finds himself in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: The possessive 's counts here: all nine letters of CHAPLAINS are rearranged by 'up the creek'.
explanation.definitionFit: A canal cut for shipping is a waterway built for vessels and their crews.

clue.text: Greek version of The Origin of Species

definitions.text: Greek version of The Origin of Species

parts.words: Greek version of The Origin of Species
parts.note: the origin of 'Species' is its first letter, S, and the Greek version of that letter is wanted

explanation.definitionFit: It is the Greek letter corresponding to the Roman S, which begins the word Species.

clue.text: A piston worked up against it

indicators.note: worked means the letters are worked into a new shape

explanation.surface: A piston pumping upward against something.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in difficulty or a tight corner means facing great trouble.

clue.text: No end of nerve, to call offering consolation

indicators.note: no end of means the synonym loses its final letter

parts.note: cheek and nerve both mean audacity
to ring up is to telephone, or call

explanation.surface: Having endless nerve to phone someone with words of comfort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No end of nerve' looks like 'plenty of nerve', but it means CHEEK minus its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Raising someone's spirits is comforting them.

clue.text: Born on outskirts of Peebles, having Scottish roots

parts.note: née, from French, marks a birth name

indicators.note: outskirts means the outermost letters of the next word

explanation.surface: Someone born near Peebles with Scottish ancestry.
explanation.walkthrough: Peebles is a Scottish Borders town; 'roots' is vegetables, not ancestry.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scotland turnips or swedes are called by this dialect name, and they are root vegetables.

clue.text: Gander with name of nurse

parts.note: a gander is British slang for a look
named after someone means given their name

explanation.surface: A goose given the name of a nurse.
explanation.walkthrough: Gander is not the goose here but British slang for a quick look.
explanation.definitionFit: To tend or care for someone is to nurse them.

clue.text: What Tyger does for Blake the poet

definitions.meaning: William Blake's poem opens 'Tyger Tyger, burning bright', so the tiger is aflame

explanation.definitionFit: The tiger in Blake's poem is burning bright, and Robert Burns is the famous Scottish poet.

clue.text: Heading for Boulogne on one vessel or another

indicators.note: heading means the first letter of the next word

parts.note: Noah's ark is a vessel

explanation.surface: Bound for Boulogne aboard one ship or another.
explanation.walkthrough: B on ARK makes another kind of vessel, so 'another' stands for another vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailing ship, a type of boat different from the ark.

clue.text: Cardinal tucked into eggs and lettuce

indicators.note: tucked into means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: roe is fish eggs
cardinal means chief, which is main

explanation.surface: A cardinal eating eggs and salad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cardinal' suggests a churchman, but it is the adjective meaning chief.
explanation.definitionFit: Cos is a variety of lettuce, also known by this name.

clue.text: Give information and reveal lonely heart, perhaps

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing to police
to let on is to reveal

explanation.surface: Informing and exposing someone's lonely heart.
explanation.definitionFit: A single person, such as one in a lonely hearts column, is an example.

clue.text: Indians move back from hyena regularly unleashed

parts.note: to go is to move

indicators.note: back from means the tail letter of the following word is taken
regularly means every other letter of the word that follows is taken

explanation.surface: Indians retreat from a hyena that has been let off its lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back from hyena' gives its final A, and the even letters of 'unleashed' give NESE.
explanation.definitionFit: Natives of Goa, a state on India's west coast, are Indians from that region.

clue.text: Propellers from San Remo

indicators.note: from here means made out of, so the letters of the town name are reworked

explanation.surface: Something that drives things forward has come from the Italian resort of San Remo.
explanation.definitionFit: Rowers drive a boat forward with their oars, so they are its propellers in a playful sense.

clue.text: Predictably, leader of Unionists interrupts a second reading

indicators.note: interrupts means one piece breaks into the middle of another

parts.note: a perusal is a careful reading

indicators.note: leader of means the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A Unionist politician, as expected, breaks in on the second reading of a bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'second reading' sounds like parliamentary procedure but splits into S and PERUSAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done in the customary way happens predictably, as it always does.

clue.text: Work on farm not starting yet

indicators.note: not starting means the first letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: still can mean yet, as in 'still to come'

explanation.surface: Farm work has not yet begun.
explanation.definitionFit: To prepare and cultivate soil for crops is agricultural labour.

clue.text: Young poet not upset by gossip

parts.note: chatter is idle talk, gossip

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the word is turned upside down, reversed

explanation.surface: A youthful poet not bothered by idle talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Chatterton was an 18th-century poet who died at seventeen.

clue.text: Moon rocket

definitions.meaning: an American family of launch rockets and missiles

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to Saturn's largest satellite and to a US launch vehicle.

clue.text: Churning out orders for heraldic emblem

indicators.note: churning means stirring, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Producing orders for a coat of arms.
explanation.definitionFit: The badge of the English Tudor dynasty is an emblem used in heraldry.

clue.text: Snag found by writer with conservationists collecting water

parts.note: a catch is a hidden snag or drawback
the writer of a clue refers to themselves as me
NT is the National Trust, the British heritage conservation charity

explanation.surface: A problem is found by an author working with conservation groups gathering water.
explanation.walkthrough: The writer is the setter, who is ME.
explanation.definitionFit: A drainage basin is where rainfall is gathered, so the word names the collection of water.

clue.text: Beginner in college studying in large open space

indicators.note: beginner means the first letter of the next word

parts.note: on course means studying a course

explanation.surface: A college freshman studying in a big hall.
explanation.definitionFit: An open central area, as in a railway station, is a big open space.

clue.text: Nuts near round bolt

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the letters that follow are scrambled

explanation.surface: Engineering talk about nuts close to a round bolt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bolt' looks like hardware with the nuts, but it means flee.
explanation.definitionFit: To flee, especially without paying a bill, is to make a sudden escape.

clue.text: Examination for which one is late

definitions.text: Examination for which one is late

parts.words: Examination for which one is late
parts.note: late here means dead, so the examination is of a body

explanation.definitionFit: A post-mortem examination is carried out on a dead person.

clue.text: God's name a source of discomfort?

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder; the 's here means 'has'

explanation.surface: Taking a god's name in vain causes some offence.
explanation.walkthrough: God's reads as God has: Thor followed by N.
explanation.definitionFit: A prickle on a plant is something that irritates, as in 'a thorn in one's side'.

clue.text: Gibbons somewhere in Florida

definitions.meaning: the first name of the English composer Gibbons

explanation.definitionFit: It is the composer Gibbons's first name and also a city in Florida.

clue.text: No leading character in non-fiction book

indicators.note: no leading character means the first letter of the synonym is dropped

parts.note: non-fiction is fact, which is truth

explanation.surface: A factual book lacking any main protagonist.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruth is a book of the Old Testament.

clue.text: Accidental shared accommodation?

definitions.meaning: in music an accidental is a sign altering a note, here one lowering it two semitones
a flat for two people to live in

explanation.definitionFit: It is a musical sign lowering a note by a whole tone, and also humorously an apartment for two.

clue.text: World War II hero ordered to join resistance

parts.note: bade means ordered
R is the symbol for resistance

explanation.surface: A war hero ordered to join the Resistance.
explanation.definitionFit: Douglas Bader was a legless RAF fighter pilot of the Second World War.

clue.text: Binders in rows

definitions.meaning: those who tie or fasten things
ranks or levels set one above another

explanation.definitionFit: People who tie are binders, and ranks of seats are rows.

clue.text: Disagreement when turning lights out

indicators.note: turning means the word is read backwards

parts.note: Taps is the bugle call for lights out

explanation.surface: An argument when switching off the lights.
explanation.definitionFit: A petty quarrel is a minor disagreement.

clue.text: Working daily, perhaps, in theory

parts.note: on means working, as a switched-on machine
a daily is a newspaper, one kind of paper

explanation.surface: A theory about working daily.
explanation.definitionFit: Something true in principle but untested holds as written rather than in practice.

clue.text: Thaw providing running water outside shelter

indicators.note: outside means one piece goes round the other

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain, so running water
a tent is a shelter

explanation.surface: A thaw provides flowing water around a shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: An easing of tension between nations is a political thaw.

clue.text: Say yes initially, taking exercise in country

parts.note: eg means for example, as 'say' does

indicators.note: initially means the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: PT is physical training, exercise

explanation.surface: Agreeing at first to do some exercise in the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Egypt is a nation in north-east Africa.

clue.text: On reflection, confident about duplicate being wrong

indicators.note: about means going round the other piece
on reflection means the word is mirrored, read backwards

parts.note: to be sure is to be confident
Roneo was a brand of stencil duplicator, so to roneo is to copy

explanation.surface: Thinking it over, a cocksure view of a copy turns out mistaken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On reflection' turns SURE into ERUS, which goes 'about' RONEO.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mistaken or incorrect is wrong.
